name: updateLocationsAdvanced
description: Changes the details of several locations at once, using their ids.

locationId.description: The location's id, as shown in search results.

newTitle.description: The location's new title. Leave it out to keep the current title; it can't be removed.

newSubtitle.description: The location's new subtitle. Leave it out to keep the current subtitle, or leave it empty to remove it.

newAddress.description: The location's new street address. Leave it out to keep the current address; it can't be removed, and it changes only together with newLatitude and newLongitude.

newLatitude.description: The new latitude of the map pin. Leave it out to keep the current position; it changes only together with newLongitude.

newLongitude.description: The new longitude of the map pin. Leave it out to keep the current position; it changes only together with newLatitude.

newAddressAlias.description: The location's new custom name. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it, so the address shows instead.

newDescription.description: The location's new description, HTML formatting kept. Leave it out to keep the current description; it can't be removed.

newListImage.description: The location's new list image. Leave it out to keep the current image; it can't be removed.

newCategoryIds.description: The ids of the categories the location is listed under, separated by commas, as the category search gives them. Every id must match a live category. Replaces every current category; subcategories that are not under the new categories are dropped, as unticking a category does. Leave it out to keep the current categories, or leave it empty to remove them all, with their subcategories.

newSubcategoryIds.description: The ids of the subcategories the location is listed under, separated by commas, as the category search gives them. Each must be a subcategory of one of the location's categories. Replaces every current subcategory, matched under the location's categories after this update. Leave it out to keep the current subcategories, or leave it empty to remove them all and keep the categories.

newPriceRange.description: The location's new price range. Leave it out to keep the current one; it can't be removed.

newPriceCurrency.description: The currency sign for the price range. Leave it out to keep the current one; it can't be removed.

newMarkerType.description: How the location is drawn on the map. Leave it out to keep the current marker; it can't be removed. Switching to Circle without a color uses red; switching to Image needs a marker image.

newMarkerColor.description: The circle marker's new rgb() or rgba() color. Leave it out to keep the current color; it can't be removed.

newMarkerImage.description: The image marker's new picture. Leave it out to keep the current one; it can't be removed.

newShowCategory.description: Whether the category is shown on the details page. Leave it out to keep the current choice; it can't be removed.

newShowOpeningHours.description: Whether the opening hours are shown on the details page. Leave it out to keep the current choice; it can't be removed. New locations get the plugin's standard week, open 08:00-20:00 every day; the hours themselves are edited in the plugin.

newShowPriceRange.description: Whether the price range is shown on the details page. Leave it out to keep the current choice; it can't be removed.

newShowStarRating.description: Whether the star rating is shown on the details page. Leave it out to keep the current choice; it can't be removed.

pinned.description: True pins the location to the top of the introduction screen (at most three can be pinned), false unpins it. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

locations.description: The changes to make, up to 50 per call, one location per entry. Each entry changes only the fields it passes, exactly as a single update would; entries carry no gallery images or action buttons.

callback.description: Runs when it's done, with each location's outcome.

error.description: Why it didn't work, such as when any entry is invalid, does not resolve or repeats a location, in which case nothing is changed.

locations.description: One outcome per input entry, in input order.

index.description: The entry's position in the input list, from 0.

id.description: The location's id, if it worked.

error.description: Why the entry failed, if it didn't.
